title: 2023, Bluffdale City Planning Commission Meeting Agenda 06-21-2023 at 6:00 p.m.

votes.motion: Commissioner Flynn moved to APPROVE the Planning Commission Meeting Minutes from May 3, 2023

Commissioner Flynn moved to recommend APPROVAL to the City Council of the proposed Ordinance Text Amendment 2023-11 as shown on Exhibits A and B based on the findings presented in the Staff Report dated June 16,2023,removing Line No.2 concerning not allowing duplexes

Commissioner Flynn moved to recommend APPROVAL to the City CouncU for the King's Cross Brixton Next Step Development Agreement (Application 2023-16) based on the following: Findings: 1. That the proposed Development Agreement facilitates redevelopment activity within the Eastern Bluffdale Economic Development Area. 2. That the proposed development has been impacted by expanded right-of-way requirements. 3. That the overall design of the project comports with the goals and objectives of the City's zoning and design ordinances
